result.evidence_quote: Bis-(di-4-phenyl-benzylaminethiocarbonyl)disulfide reverses cisplatin resistance in a cisplatin-resistant variant of A549 cells (via ALDH and ABCC2 inhibition) but not in NCI-H158 cells.
result.rationale: The study investigates molecular mechanisms and treatment of cisplatin resistance in non-small-cell lung cancer. It does not address cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk prediction or prevention, or therapies for cardiovascular outcomes.
